remainingQualification: Exact DMG contents, clean installation, upgrade and product review must also pass.

checks.detail: Signing and notarization must run on macOS
Developer ID Application certificate and private key are installed
Notarization credentials or a Keychain profile name must be configured; profile validity is established during submission
Form Studio 0.40.0 main app identity and version match
App carries a Developer ID signature, not an ad-hoc signature
Apple notarization ticket is stapled and validates
Current-version DMGs must have valid team signatures and stapled tickets

externalActions: Enroll in the paid Apple Developer Program and install a Developer ID Application certificate.
Provide notarization credentials through the release secret store.
Build, sign, submit, staple, and validate on a clean release commit.
Install and upgrade the notarized DMG on a clean Mac before public release.
